pinreg_r4: r4 (2026-10-15): die master is pin-registered (PR=1, tools/qwen_split/d2d_pinreg_gen.py): every functional port has one flop at its pin, placed FIRM at the pin by recipe-2 io_flop_at_pins; fixes qkd r1 EARLY_FAIL_SETUP (-434 ps, all boundary paths) and qfd r1 TT -79 / FF -32.6.
structural_change: sf5 (QW-D2D 10-19): RTL successor qfd_d2d_static_ovl_sf (ot_qwen_d2d_safe5.sv): right-sized sparse-pin slot store SRAM ot_sram_1r1w_64x137_m1_r2c2_p192 (57.9x45.7, 229 pins/face at 0.192 um = 5.2/um; the 64x512 used 137/512 columns at 10.4/um), KEPT copies for every >32-load register in the r9j/mu1 census (hit_age, calendar ptr/seg1 -> registered one-hot, fire, cmd_ws/s1 -> one-hot, result_v/cfg_data/cal_start/cal_seg pin-flop copies, epoch_begin), cycle-identical to qfd_d2d_static_ovl (lockstep bench 200k cycles). Outline 345.6x216 (was 475.2x280.8: -44%), macros 2x2 on the 43.2 lattice with 10.8 um halos, full-width std band between rows, pins re-spread at 0.192 um on full faces, ck at the N centre track.

pin_regs.reason: RTL is already pin-registered: d2d_pinreg_gen.py PR=1 wraps qfd_d2d_static_core with exactly one flop per functional port (FIRM at the pin via io_flop_at_pins); the link calendar is compiled --pinreg; a second synthesized pin register would add +1 cycle per port with no timing purpose

reset_landing.reason: the RTL lands it: ot_rst_pipe u_reset_regions / u_por_region s0 -> s1 (kept 2-flop capture, async assert / sync release, FIRM at the E-face rst_n / por_n pins by local_reset_capture.tcl; port net = 2 sinks), then 8 equal-depth regional copies (RC 1, each <= ~160 loads; r9j 300/325 on one flop). A kit landing would add 2 more stages and rename u_core (breaks the capture anchor).

safe_design.1_pins: PASS: every functional port has its own pin flop (PR=1); the 9 high-fanout inputs (cfg_data, cal_start[_rx], cal_seg[_rx], result_v) have KEPT pin-flop copies, all capture flops of one port FIRM at its pin (io_flop_at_pins handles multi-capture). Reset: RTL 2-stage capture (ot_rst_pipe s0/s1, async assert / sync release) FIRM at the E rst_n/por_n pins + equal-depth regional stages; kit reset_landing opt-out with reason (it would add 2 stages on top of the RTL landing).
safe_design.2_reach: PASS by construction: 345.6 x 216 outline, max pin-flop to macro Manhattan < 405 um; no relay needed. Gate timing confirms.
safe_design.3_fanout: FIXED in source: every >32-load register of the r9j/mu1 native census (hit_age 1072/548, cal ptr/seg1 ~900-1027, fire 374-553, result_v 302, epoch_begin 215, cmd_ws/s1 73-76, cfg_data 66, cal_start/seg 39-50) is a KEPT copy (<=32) or a registered one-hot; reset regions split by the same-edge copy hook (<=32 terminal loads). Copies kept through synthesis by route.synth_keep_modules (non-parameterised ot_d2d_kff/kffr).
safe_design.4_depth: PASS: logic unchanged except one-hot table reads (shallower than the 32:1 binary mux); mu1 measured depth ~483 ps @ 770 ps; gate confirms.
safe_design.5_storage: PASS: slot store = 4 x 64x137 SRAM macros; calendar tables 2 x 1 kb flops (<2 kb each) read through a registered one-hot pointer; TXD capture delays 1-bit shift registers <=10 deep (waived: a ring costs more).
safe_design.6_floorplan: PASS: right-sized macro ot_sram_1r1w_64x137_m1_r2c2_p192 (57.9 x 45.7 um, 229 pins/face at 0.192 um = 5.23/um), 2 x 2 on the 43.2 lattice with 10.8 um halos; channels 158 um (centre), 40.7 um between rows (full-width std band), 41/26 um outer; all 3668 external pins at 0.192 um (5.2/um) on full faces; aspect 1.6. Utilisation waived: pin-limited outline (N face 1674 pins x 0.192 = 321 um), std ~6.5k um2 in 74.6k um2 (-44% vs 475.2 x 280.8).
safe_design.7_clock: Centre-fed: ck on the N centre track (172.812), CTS sink clustering 20/40; spread <=80 TT+FF checked by the gate; io_hold_margin 0.03.
safe_design.8_schedule: PASS: 0 added edges (lockstep equivalence vs qfd_d2d_static_ovl 200k cycles; pair bench 35 layers bit-exact at TXDP [8,3,1,10] = compiled_L1 dv2f18dh2). Static calendars, no credits/backpressure.
